text.arabic_uthmani: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا

words.gloss_range: conjunctive opening that carries the following day-scene as a connected temporal frame
words.prose: The opening particle keeps the scene joined to the prior reckoning discourse and immediately loads the next word as a time-frame. The reader enters a continued Judgment-Day panel, with the same opening pattern recalling the earlier scene-frame in 18:47.

topics.headline: opening particle governs the time-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens inside a temporal frame rather than as a detached new subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the opening as a conjunction introducing the temporal clause.

topics.headline: continued reckoning scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the summons as a continuation of the same eschatological reckoning sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction links this scene to the preceding discourse rather than isolating it.

topics.headline: wa-yawma echo with 18:47
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this as another staged Judgment-Day panel alongside the earlier wa-yawma frame (18:47).
topics.reason: The concrete 18:47 parallel supports a local structural echo without changing the particle's grammar.

words.gloss_range: accusative time-frame for the whole summons, response failure, and imposed separation
words.root_gloss_range: time/day field, often singular in reckoning scenes; locally selected as an accusative temporal frame
words.prose: The noun names the scene as a bounded Day and functions as an accusative time adverb for everything that follows: divine speech, command, attempted call, silence, and separation. In the surah sequence, the same day-frame moves from cosmic exposure (18:47) to the exposed record (18:49) and now to exposed allegiance.

topics.headline: accusative temporal adverb frames the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole sequence is contained in one decisive time-frame.
topics.reason: Local grammar makes yawma an accusative temporal adverb governed by the speech verb.

topics.headline: singular bounded reckoning moment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the alleged partners tested at a single converging moment, not across ordinary time.
topics.reason: The singular local noun supports a bounded reckoning scene; frequency data is background, not a new sense.

topics.headline: day as frame for claim and response testing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Day as the place where speech, calling, and response are tested together.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with local words for saying, calling, alleged partners, and response.

topics.headline: Surah 18 sequence of day-scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene as part of a Surah 18 progression from landscape exposure (18:47), to record exposure (18:49), to allegiance exposure (18:52).
topics.reason: The repeated concrete references support a surah-internal sequence; 18:51 also explains the move from timeless denial to dated public consequence.

words.gloss_range: vivid divine saying that opens a quoted command and turns the claim into a trial
words.root_gloss_range: saying/speech field; locally selected as divine speech that governs a quoted command
words.prose: The imperfect speech verb makes the Judgment scene vivid as an unfolding present and opens the quoted test-command. It does more than report information: divine saying makes the claimants enact their claim. Variant evidence can make the speaker or addressee more explicit, but the local aligned form remains a reported divine saying that governs the command. The speech scene also reverses faithful refusal to call others (18:14), contrasts human panic over the record (18:49), and carries the movement from divine self-description (18:51) into sovereign action.

topics.headline: variant readings clarify speaker or addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variation can make the divine speaker or addressed audience more explicit, while the local aligned wording keeps reported divine speech.
topics.reason: The variants are useful contrast, but they do not replace the aligned local surface.

topics.headline: imperfect as vivid narration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the Judgment scene as present and unfolding rather than coldly reported.
topics.reason: The imperfect form stands inside the Day-frame and introduces direct speech.

topics.headline: divine speech opens the trial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees saying become the mechanism that forces the alleged partnership into action.
topics.reason: The verb governs the quoted imperative, and the local call-response words show the speech setting up the test.

topics.headline: speech shifts across nearby scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the judgment command against Surah 18 contrasts: faithful refusal to call others (18:14), human panic over the record (18:49), and the shift from divine self-description (18:51) to sovereign action.
topics.reason: The concrete references support contrast without making them govern the local parse.

words.gloss_range: plural imperative summons, directed at the alleged partners inside divine speech
words.root_gloss_range: calling/summoning field with assembly pressure in the root-family; locally Form III directed summons is selected
words.prose: The imperative is a plural command inside divine speech, forcing the whole claiming group to attempt its own doctrine. Its Form III directed-summons force makes the alleged partners the target of an answerable call, while the later Form I calling shows that the attempted contact collapses into a weaker report. Root-family assembly pressure survives only as imagery: a summons should gather a respondent body, but none appears.

topics.headline: plural imperative opens the test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command makes the claimants publicly enact the alliance that 18:51 has already denied as support.
topics.reason: The imperative is embedded in divine speech and takes the alleged partners as its direct object.

topics.headline: Form III directed call toward respondents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the call as a directed summons that should reach a respondent, not as vague shouting.
topics.reason: The Form III local verb and direct object support directed address.

topics.headline: assembly pressure without changing the verb sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the summons aiming toward a gathered responsive body, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as calling or summoning.
topics.reason: The council-place derivative is root-family pressure, not the direct local meaning of the imperative.

topics.headline: summons gives way to bare calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from formal summons to the later ordinary calling, matching the collapse of claimed access.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the directed summons before the later Form I calling and non-response.

words.gloss_range: alleged partners as a plural possessed object, immediately restricted as claim-dependent
words.root_gloss_range: sharing/partnership field ranging from ordinary sharing to condemned divine association; locally alleged divine partnership is selected
words.prose: The alleged partners are placed as the direct object of the summons, but the construct suffix puts the claim into divine speech with sharp irony: they are called "My partners" only as the claim being tested. The following relative clause immediately makes the title claim-dependent. The root can name ordinary sharing, but here the local frame narrows it to alleged divine association that will fail under summons. The hamza-smoothing variant leaves that possessed partner-noun function intact, and the scene belongs to a partner-exposure pattern with judgment summons in 6:22, 10:28, 16:27, and 28:62-64, regret over association in 18:42, and final refusal of association in 18:110.

topics.headline: object of summons immediately restricted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the partners are made reachable in grammar only to be withdrawn into the claim that produced them.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the command and is immediately qualified by the relative clause.

topics.headline: construct plus first-person suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony of the possessive form: the alleged partners enter God's own speech as a challenged attribution.
topics.reason: The plural construct with first-person suffix is local morphology, and the following claim clause prevents taking it as real partnership.

topics.headline: ordinary sharing narrowed to alleged divine association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees neutral partnership language narrowed into a condemned claim about sharing in God's domain.
topics.reason: The broad root range remains relevant as pressure, but the local summons and claim frame select alleged divine association.

topics.headline: hamza smoothing does not change the referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that phonetic variation leaves the possessed partner-noun function intact.
topics.reason: The variant is useful apparatus, but it does not alter the local referent or syntax.

topics.headline: partner claim exposed across Quranic and Surah 18 scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a partner-exposure pattern: judgment summons in 6:22, 10:28, 16:27, and 28:62-64, regret over association in 18:42, and final refusal of association in 18:110.
topics.reason: The concrete references support a claim-exposure network while the local noun remains governed by the summons.

words.gloss_range: restrictive relative marker that makes the partners identifiable only through the claim that follows
words.prose: The relative pronoun does crucial narrowing work: the alleged partners are identifiable only as those the addressees claimed. It agrees with the plural noun and pushes the reader forward to the claim verb. The missing explicit object in that claim leaves the indictment wide, but the local clause still restricts the partners rather than creating a new independent entity.

topics.headline: relative clause makes identity claim-dependent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged partners do not stand independently; their identity is suspended until the claim verb supplies it.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun modifies the partner noun and introduces the restrictive claim clause.

topics.headline: relative clause with open claim content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the charge widen because the claim's exact object is omitted, while the grammar still keeps the relative clause tied to the alleged partners.
topics.reason: The elision is local to the following verb and does not make the relative pronoun itself semantically independent.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural prior claim, with its object left open and its force suspicious rather than evidential
words.root_gloss_range: claim/assertion field, often carrying suspicion; locally a prior unproven claim is selected
words.prose: The perfect second-person verb fixes the allegation as something the very addressees had already made. Its object is omitted, so the indictment can cover whatever status, power, or efficacy they asserted for the partners. The root and Quranic usage carry suspicion, but that pressure is local: the word marks an unverified claim that is about to be tested by call and non-response. Guarantor pressure makes the claimants stand behind what they alleged without changing the verb's local sense, and the repeated claim field links the false-partner claim to the nearby denial of the meeting in 18:48 before the scene moves directly into enactment.

topics.headline: claim content left open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is not narrowed to one phrasing; the whole claimed status of the partners is exposed.
topics.reason: The verb has no explicit object clause in the local wording.

topics.headline: assertion without proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the partnership as allegation rather than knowledge before the response-test even begins.
topics.reason: The root pressure supports suspicion, but the local selected sense remains claiming or asserting.

topics.headline: claimants become responsible for their claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the claimants being held responsible to stand behind what they alleged, while the local verb still means claimed.
topics.reason: The guarantor noun is root-family pressure and should not replace the local finite verb meaning.

topics.headline: same group commanded and indicted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the commanded group identified as the same group that had made the prior claim.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix aligns with the plural addressees of the command.

topics.headline: claim formula moves into enacted test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the false-partner claim to a repeated claim field and to the nearby denial of the meeting in 18:48 before the scene moves directly into the test.
topics.reason: The local relative clause closes on the claim verb and is followed immediately by the result sequence; 18:48 supplies a concrete same-surah claim contrast.

words.gloss_range: sequential consequence marker moving at once from command to enacted call
words.prose: The first result particle gives the command no room to remain theoretical. It moves directly from "summon" to the performed call, starting the compressed chain that will reach silence in the next result clause.

topics.headline: swift consequence after the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged relationship is tested immediately, without deliberation or delay.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the response following the command.

topics.headline: first step in compressed action-failure chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels command, attempt, and failure compressed into one rapid sequence.
topics.reason: The first result particle begins the local chain that the second result particle completes.

words.gloss_range: completed calling of the alleged partners, with the object suffix carrying them into the failed-response clause
words.root_gloss_range: calling/invocation and claim/petition field; locally completed invocation of the alleged partners is selected
words.prose: The perfect verb reports the call as completed, and the object suffix pulls the alleged partners from the command into the failed-response scene. The shift from the earlier directed summons to this simpler Form I calling lowers the register: the doctrine is enacted grammatically, but its substance collapses when no answer follows. The invocation also has petition-like pressure, but locally it remains the actual calling of the named partners. The call field contrasts faithful refusal to call another deity (18:14) with this exposed dependence, while 18:57 adds a nearby refusal around divine signs.

topics.headline: completed call with object suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is actually performed; the failure belongs to the partners' inability to answer, not to an unmade call.
topics.reason: The perfect verb and object suffix show completed calling of the same alleged partners.

topics.headline: invocation as denied petition pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the call as an appeal that will be denied, while local grammar keeps it as calling the partners.
topics.reason: The legal-claim pressure is root-family color and does not replace the local verb sense.

topics.headline: from addressed command to reported bare calling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the claimants move from second-person defendants to third-person reported actors, and from directed summons to basic calling.
topics.reason: The local morphology changes person-frame and form from the earlier summons verb.

topics.headline: call field exposed by non-response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 18:52 against Surah 18 contrasts: the youths refuse to call another deity (18:14), while false claimants call their partners, and 18:57 shows another refusal around divine signs.
topics.reason: The concrete references support contrast in the call field, while local syntax supplies the direct object and next response failure.

words.gloss_range: second result marker, moving immediately from the call to negated response
words.prose: The second result particle turns the completed call directly into its verdict. It does not merely add another event; it makes non-response the immediate consequence, leaving no narrative interval in which help could arrive.

topics.headline: immediate negated result after the call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer fails as soon as the call is made; the test closes without a space for hope.
topics.reason: The second result particle introduces the negated response clause after the completed call.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator that scopes over the response verb and makes the expected answer a completed non-event
words.prose: The negator scopes forward onto the response verb, not backward onto the call. That distinction matters: the summons really happens, while the answer is made a completed non-event under jussive government. Its categorical force makes the expected response structurally unavailable, not merely delayed.

topics.headline: negator governs the response verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the call remain intact while only the answer-slot is negated and cut off.
topics.reason: QAC grammar identifies the particle as governing the following imperfect jussive.

topics.headline: strong past-negative force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the non-response as categorical, while the local evidence should not be inflated into a free claim about every possible negator.
topics.reason: The lam-plus-jussive construction supports completed negation here; comparison with other negators is a narrowing aid only.

words.gloss_range: negated Form X response/compliance to a call, with the alleged partners failing in the responder role
words.root_gloss_range: answering/responding field with cut-through imagery; locally Form X responsive compliance is negated
words.prose: The called object now becomes the plural subject that fails to respond. Form X points to responsive compliance to a call, and the following prepositional phrase makes the failure relational: no answer comes for the callers. Root imagery of an answer cutting through silence survives as pressure, but the local clause selects negated response, clipped by the jussive after the negator. The negated call-response field also recalls unanswered-call scenes in 17:52 and 46:5 and the partner-call nonresponse in 28:64.

topics.headline: called partners fail as responding subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the alleged partners moved into the exact responder role they cannot fill.
topics.reason: The verb is plural and is completed by the following prepositional complement.

topics.headline: clipped jussive form after negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the expected response grammatically shortened under the negator.
topics.reason: The jussive form follows the negating particle and loses the indicative ending.

topics.headline: answer/compliance with cut-through imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses an answer that should cut through silence and perform compliance, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as responding.
topics.reason: Cutting or depression imagery is root pressure and does not replace the local Form X response meaning.

topics.headline: call-response field negated in partner scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the call-response test as a false-support exposure, especially alongside unanswered-call scenes in 17:52, 46:5, and the partner-call nonresponse in 28:64.
topics.reason: The local call and negated response license the field; the concrete references clarify the broader pattern.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the intended beneficiary or recipient of a response that never arrives
words.prose: The preposition marks the intended recipient or beneficiary of a response, so the negated verb does not mean only that no sound came back. It means no answer arrived for them. Attachment evidence keeps the phrase inside the response clause, while pronoun ambiguity can remain as a secondary pressure in the broken relation.

topics.headline: beneficiary relation remains empty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the failed answer measured by the benefit or directed response it should have delivered.
topics.reason: The preposition marks the complement of the response verb and carries the intended recipient relation.

topics.headline: phrase belongs to the failed answer clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the relational failure located in the answer-clause itself, not merely in the earlier call.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the prepositional phrase to the response verb.

topics.headline: possible ambiguity mirrors relation confusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may feel the plural relation blur, while the strongest local reading still points to the callers as intended recipients.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence favors the callers for this pronoun, so ambiguity is retained as pressure rather than control.

words.gloss_range: attached plural pronoun in the failed-response phrase, most directly the callers while retaining relational ambiguity
words.prose: The attached plural pronoun most directly lands the non-response on the callers: they are the ones for whom no answer comes. Yet it also participates in the ayah's wider plural chain, linking the failed-response phrase to the later between-space where the broken relation is made visible.

topics.headline: pronoun resolves most directly to the callers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failed response lands on the claimants themselves.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence identifies the pronoun in the prepositional phrase as referring to the callers.

topics.headline: plural ambiguity mirrors the broken relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses confusion between callers and called entities, while local evidence still favors the callers as recipient.
topics.reason: The ambiguity is meaningful as scene pressure but should not override the stronger local referent.

topics.headline: same plural field moves toward separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the failed response and later between-space linked by a repeated plural relation.
topics.reason: The pronoun chain connects the partner/caller network from the prior verse into the final separation clause.

words.gloss_range: coordinating pivot from human calling and silence to divine action
words.prose: This conjunction pivots from the compressed failure of call and silence into a new divine action. Unlike the two quick result particles, it opens a distinct clause where sovereignty arranges the consequence. The speaker shift to first-person plural is real, but it should be read as a local register shift or exit from quotation, not as a separate topic detached from the making verb.

topics.headline: coordination opens sovereign action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turn from human impotence to divine placement of the consequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the divine action clause after the failed response sequence.

topics.headline: speaker frame shifts into first-person plural action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a register shift from reported divine saying to first-person plural action, while the local function remains coordination into the making clause.
topics.reason: The shift is bound to the following first-person plural verb and does not independently alter the conjunction's syntax.

words.gloss_range: perfect first-person plural making/placing verb that turns the relation-space into ruin
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, or arranging field; locally an arrangement of an existing relation is selected
words.prose: The perfect first-person plural verb governs the final frame: the between-space is where the action lands, and the final noun names what that space becomes. The verb presents the placement as accomplished inside the Judgment scene. Its making is arrangement rather than creation from nothing: the existing false relation is transformed into a ruinous divide. The first-person plural agency takes over after the plural claimants and partners fail, carrying the register shift from 18:51 into execution. Surah 18 barrier echoes sharpen the contrast, since the making-between structure can be protective in 18:94-96 but here becomes judgment, and 18:57 shares divine making as imposed blockage.

topics.headline: making verb controls between-space and final noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the relation-space itself made into the verdict, not merely two parties separated.
topics.reason: The verb governs the locative complement and final object/predicate frame.

topics.headline: completed divine placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the separation as accomplished within the scene rather than a pending threat.
topics.reason: The perfect form presents the divine action as complete in the narrative frame.

topics.headline: making as arranging an existing relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the false relation rearranged into ruin, while the local verb should not be turned into an abstract dictionary contrast by itself.
topics.reason: The making/placing sense is locally licensed; the contrast with creation language narrows the kind of making.

topics.headline: first-person plural agency after plural failures
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees final agency move from claimants and partners to divine action, continuing the shift from 18:51 into 18:52.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix carries the subject in the perfect verb.

topics.headline: failed invocation converted into separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine making as the imposed aftermath of failed invocation and the conversion of claimed sharing into separation.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from calling and non-response to the making clause.

topics.headline: making-between echoes become judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the making-between grammar against Surah 18: the protective barrier requested in 18:94-96 is inverted into judgment here, and 18:57 shares divine making as imposed blockage.
topics.reason: The concrete references support internal echo and contrast without replacing the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: between-space with plural suffix, the relational interval that receives the divine making
words.root_gloss_range: between, separation, and clarity field; locally the relation-space between plural parties is selected
words.prose: The word marks the relational interval where the divine making lands. The reader first sees "between them" and only afterward learns that the interval becomes ruin, so the syntax turns relation-space into a suspenseful verdict. The plural suffix fuses the parties to the gap that divides them. Root pressure from separation and clarity survives as disclosure, but local grammar keeps the word as a between-space, not an independent proof term. The between-field also contrasts the protective barrier request of 18:94 with the meeting-place between the two seas in 18:61, turning junction or protection into rupture.

topics.headline: between-space governed by the making verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of judgment is the relation-space itself before its destructive nature is named.
topics.reason: The adverbial complement is governed by the making verb and precedes the final noun.

topics.headline: between whom remains relationally open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the relational field as broad, while local discourse favors the callers and alleged partners as the main divided parties.
topics.reason: The pronoun has ambiguity, but the immediate call-response scene constrains the primary referents.

topics.headline: separation also exposes falseness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the gap disclose the false partnership, while local grammar keeps baynahum as between-space rather than proof itself.
topics.reason: Clarity/evidence pressure belongs to the root field and is locally realized through separation.

topics.headline: fixed adverb plus plural suffix
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the parties are grammatically attached to the very interval that will divide them.
topics.reason: The fixed adverbial form combines with the plural suffix in the local word.

topics.headline: between-field contrasts in Surah 18
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the between-space against the protective barrier request of 18:94 and the meeting-place between the two seas in 18:61, turning junction or protection into rupture.
topics.reason: The concrete references support a between-field echo while the local clause remains the judgment scene.

words.gloss_range: indefinite ruinous locus or condition made between them, combining perdition, entrapment, and barrier-like separation
words.root_gloss_range: perishing and being stuck fast; locally a spatialized place or condition of ruin is selected
words.prose: The final indefinite noun names what the between-space has become: a ruinous locus or condition. Its role is best narrowed to the second object or predicative completion of the making verb, while its form keeps place-like and state-like force close. The indefinite ending leaves the ruin unspecified and stark. Root pressure joins perishing with being stuck fast, and Surah 18 itself reinforces the rare field when the same root appears again in 18:58. Against the protective barrier motif of 18:94, and against other barrier scenes in 23:100 and 55:20, this is not a neutral wall but destructive separation.

topics.headline: final noun completes the making frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the last word define the previously neutral between-space as ruin, while grammar most safely treats it as the final complement of the making verb.
topics.reason: The local evidence supports the second-object or predicate role; broader role ambiguity is retained only as nearby place/state pressure.

topics.headline: indefinite mafʿil-like ruin locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final noun as an unnamed, singularly forceful ruin-zone rather than a familiar labeled barrier.
topics.reason: The indefinite accusative and place-pattern pressure support a spatialized locus of ruin.

topics.headline: perishing joined to being stuck fast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses ruin as entrapment in the failed relation, while local grammar keeps the word as the made noun rather than a separate action.
topics.reason: The root pressure combines perdition and stuckness, but the local form names a locus or condition.

topics.headline: rare root concentrated in Surah 18
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final noun tied to Surah 18's own destruction vocabulary through the same rare root in 18:58.
topics.reason: The concrete 18:58 echo links the place of ruin here with later destructive action.

topics.headline: protective barrier inverted into destructive separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader contrasts this destructive between-space with the protective barrier request in 18:94 and with other barrier terms such as 23:100 and 55:20.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete barrier comparisons; they sharpen the final noun without making it a generic barrier term.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence commands a call to the alleged partners, reports an actual calling, and then negates any answer to the callers.
baseline_models.mechanism: A claim of partnership is converted into a vocal responsiveness test: named associates are addressed as parties able to act, but silence exposes the claim as unsupported.

activation_trace.role: A raised audible call supplies the public summons that initiates the test.
Shared participation supplies the relation whose practical reality is being tested.
An assertion lacking certainty marks the partnership as a claim awaiting verification.
Calling and drawing by speech turns the prior assertion into an attempted interaction.
Reply to speech or appeal supplies the expected performance whose negation decides the test.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that false partners fail to answer.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a public verification procedure in which an asserted partnership must answer for itself and fails at the point of response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alleged partners are called by those who asserted them, yet provide no response before the intervening mawbiq is made.
baseline_models.mechanism: The guaranty branch of claiming combines with shared participation: the callers have treated the partners as co-liable backers, and the unanswered summons exposes that no party will assume the promised burden.

activation_trace.role: Partnership supplies shared standing and the expectation that another party will participate.
Assuming guaranty supplies the liability-bearing role implicitly assigned to the alleged partners.
The absent reply is the failed act by which a guarantor would acknowledge and meet the claim.
Inescapable entrapment supplies the consequence once the supposed guaranty proves unavailable.

changed_reading.before: The partners are unavailable objects of appeal.
changed_reading.after: The partners are exposed as imaginary co-guarantors: when called to assume responsibility, none acknowledges the liability and the claimants remain caught.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: God makes a mawbiq precisely between the callers and the called partners.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial term can name both a connective relation and separation; making an obstructive, trapping mawbiq in that relational interval converts alleged association into enforced disjunction.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate transformation supplies the conversion of a claimed relation into a contrary condition.
A standing connection between parties supplies the relation presupposed by partnership.
Separation after association supplies the reversal enacted in the same between-space.
A barrier between two sides gives the reversal a concrete relational form.
Entrapment without release makes the separation punitive rather than merely spatial.

changed_reading.before: A barrier is placed between two already distinct groups.
changed_reading.after: The very interval once imagined as partnership is deliberately remade into separation and capture; the claimed bond becomes its own site of failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure, universal gathering, alignment, an obligatory record, and the presence of deeds turn the summons into evidentiary production: the alleged partners are called as parties or witnesses within a complete public audit.

activation_trace.role: The uncertain assertion supplies the proposition that the audit now tests.
The direct call functions as an order to produce the asserted parties.
Open exposure removes concealment and supplies the audit's visible field.
Driving and collecting a group to one destination supplies universal attendance.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered presentation before judgment.
A written fixing that obligates judgment supplies the controlling record.
Presence with direct view supplies the immediate availability of the deeds as evidence.

structural_cues: 18:47 gathers everyone on exposed ground, 18:48 presents them in a row, and 18:49 makes both record and deeds present before the summons of 18:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total exposure, attendance, order, record, and presence; I infer that calling the alleged partners is an evidentiary production order. A live alternative is that these details provide only dramatic humiliation, not a juridical procedure.

changed_reading.before: The call privately demonstrates that the partners cannot help.
changed_reading.after: Inside a universal public audit, the call demands production of the very parties asserted by the defendants; their nonresponse becomes adverse evidence against the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior choice of substitute protectors who are actually enemies, followed by denial that misleaders were witnesses or supports, specifies what the alleged partners fail to do: they possess neither standing nor supportive capacity.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies the role the chosen substitutes were imagined to occupy.
Guaranty supplies the expected burden-bearing capacity tested by the summons.
Failure to reply supplies the observable failure to assume that protective role.
Loyalty and support name the protective capacity expected from the chosen substitutes.
Actual enmity reverses the protective relation before it is tested.
One thing standing in place of another frames the partners as failed substitute protectors.
Presence with observation supplies witness standing that the misleaders never possessed.
An arm-like helper supplies the executive support explicitly denied before the summons.

structural_cues: 18:50 calls the chosen allies enemies and a bad substitution; 18:51 denies misleaders any role in witnessing creation or serving as support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substituted allies, enmity, absent witness standing, and absent support; I infer that 18:52 compels those supposed protectors to assume liability. The live alternative is a looser contrast between two independent rebukes.

changed_reading.before: The called partners are generic false objects of devotion.
changed_reading.after: They are would-be substitute protectors and co-guarantors summoned to perform the standing and support attributed to them; silence proves that the substitution never created capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later description of covered hearts, burdened ears, and a futile call toward guidance mirrors the call and failed response in the focus: prior unresponsiveness is returned as an unanswered appeal.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the appeal now made by the claimants.
Negated response supplies the mirrored failure at the center of the focus.
A protecting cover becomes a barrier to reception and supplies inward unresponsiveness.
Heaviness in the ear supplies outward failure to receive a call.
The repeated act of calling creates the explicit verbal mirror between guidance and appeal.
Gentle direction to the right path supplies the call to which the later callers had remained unavailable.

structural_cues: 18:57 repeats the call construction while describing blocked understanding and hearing, then states that the addressees will never be guided.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two calls and two structures of inability; I infer a reciprocal judgment arrow from refusal or incapacity toward guidance to an unanswered appeal to chosen partners. They may alternatively be parallel examples without direct reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The partners simply cannot answer their callers.
changed_reading.after: Those who remained closed to a call toward guidance undergo its relational mirror: when they become callers, their chosen addressees are closed to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sight of fire, expected falling into it, absence of diversion, later appointed time, lack of refuge, and appointed destruction develop the mawbiq from a static barrier into a scheduled holding condition with no exit.

activation_trace.role: The interval between parties supplies the spatial site in which the no-exit condition is made.
Entrapment that cannot be escaped supplies the holding mechanism.
Falling into destruction supplies the terminal direction of the trap.
A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the trap's appointed timing.
Blazing fire supplies the visible destination immediately beyond the mawbiq.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies movement from expectation into unavoidable contact.
Turning something away supplies the unavailable escape route.
Refuge and rescue supply the second form of exit explicitly denied.
Collapse into destruction supplies the appointed endpoint of the no-exit sequence.

structural_cues: 18:53 immediately follows the mawbiq with fire, expected encounter, and no diversion; 18:58 denies refuge from an appointment; 18:59 joins appointment to destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, encounter, denied diversion, denied refuge, appointment, and destruction; I infer causal continuity from the between-space to a holding zone and endpoint. A live alternative leaves mawbiq as relational separation only.

changed_reading.before: The mawbiq is a barrier separating callers from partners.
changed_reading.after: The made between-space is an appointed no-exit holding zone: it arrests the failed alliance, exposes its occupants to the destination ahead, and permits neither diversion nor refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding contest between tightly wound dispute, assertions without reality, attempts to make truth lose footing, and stable truth recasts the summons as compelled argument: the alleged partners cannot provide the reply needed to sustain the claim.

activation_trace.role: A statement lacking certainty supplies the disputed claim put under pressure.
A reply in dialogue supplies the argumentative performance that never arrives.
Twisted, interlocked contention supplies the human habit that frames the claim.
The repeated contentious mechanism supplies the active attempt to preserve falsehood.
A claim with no reality supplies the category into which unsupported partnership falls.
A proof losing its footing supplies the intended argumentative displacement and its reversal.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the failed reply cannot dislodge.

structural_cues: 18:54 names the human as exceptionally disputatious after varied examples; 18:56 specifies dispute by falsehood as an attempt to dislodge truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disputed falsehood, attempted displacement, stable truth, and the focus's unanswered claim; I infer that the summons forces the claim to perform as an argument. The alternative is a thematic link between separate failures rather than one adjudicative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The scene is a failed devotional appeal.
changed_reading.after: It is also the collapse of an argument under compelled response: the named partners cannot furnish the answer required to give the asserted relation any footing against reality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunter's-snare branch of the same root behind the ordinary plural 'partners'; it remains anchored by that focus root and by mawbiq's explicit entrapment branch. Render it only as exploratory root-play that exposes a mechanism, not as a replacement translation of 'partners.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The asserted partners and the inescapable mawbiq occur in one short causal sequence.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies an exploratory reversal in which the alleged partnership is also what catches its claimant.
Entrapment without release supplies the explicit focus mechanism that keeps the snare image anchored.

changed_reading.before: The partners fail, after which a separate trap or barrier appears.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the claimed partnership is already the claimant's snare, and the mawbiq externalizes the entanglement latent in that relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because it maps the plant-cycle image of mixing, drying, and scattering onto a social partnership; it remains anchored in the focus's partnership, between-space, and separation. Render it as a sequence-triggered material analogy, not as a lexical claim about the focus nouns.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from alleged shared participation to a made separation in the space between the parties.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation supplies the apparently integrated social network.
Separation after association supplies the network's final disaggregation.
Social mixing and partnership of holdings supply the analogy's temporary interwoven state.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the loss of cohesion before separation.
Winnowing and wind-scattering supply the final dispersal of what had appeared mixed together.

changed_reading.before: The partnership is a stable but false relation that is later severed.
changed_reading.after: The partnership can be carried as a temporary mixed network whose apparent cohesion dries, fragments, and is formally separated in the mawbiq.

strongest_changes: The summons becomes a public evidentiary audit of an asserted relationship, not merely a failed request for help.
The alleged partners are specified as substitute protectors or co-guarantors who possess neither witness standing nor supportive capacity.
The unanswered appeal mirrors the callers' own closure to a call toward guidance.
The mawbiq develops into an appointed no-exit holding condition leading toward destruction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repeatedly converts relation into procedure: assertion becomes summons, partnership becomes tested liability, silence becomes evidence, and the shared between-space becomes separation and capture.
remaining_uncertainties: The guarantor reading is branch-supported but extends beyond the ordinary immediate force of za'amtum.
The reciprocal nonresponse model depends on reading the later call toward guidance as a deliberate mirror rather than a parallel case.
The snare and mixed-network readings should remain exploratory mechanisms rather than lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Claimed partnership becomes engineered separation.** `ج ع ل` B002 (“turning something into a state”) places a destructive gulf between callers and alleged partners. This reverses `ش ر ك` B001’s image of shared participation and anticipates the protective barrier made between peoples (18:94–96). I infer that judgment materializes the true non-relation concealed by cultic claims. Calling fails because no operative partnership ever existed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The protective separation built at 18:94–98 showed that a made “between” can preserve or destroy according to function.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The relational gap becomes the trap.** `و ب ق/B001` is a barrier between two things; `و ب ق/B003` is being caught fast and unable to get free, and `B002` is ruin. Calling and failed response prove the distance between claimants and claimed partners; 18:53 then presents fire with no route of diversion. I infer that the very relation imagined as access hardens into separation and detention. `مَوْبِقًا` reads as failed partnership materialized into its own ruinous interval.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:53’s absent `مَصْرِفًا` showed that the separating interval is also detention; the relational gap itself has become inescapable.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claimed source of strength is exposed as false when crisis demands actual rescue, testimony, response, or escape.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Punitive Enclosure Blocks Relief, Response, and Escape
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire surrounds like a pavilion, false allies remain across an obstructing separation without answering, and Hell stands prepared as final lodging.

branches.what_is_ar: اليوم المعروف: وقت من طلوع الشمس إلى غروبها، وهو الواحد من الأيام وجمعه أيام.
اليوم بمعنى مدة من الزمان أي مدة كانت، أو بمعنى الدهر في بعض الاستعمال.
يدخل فيه استعارة اليوم للأمر العظيم، والكائنة إذا نزلت، واليوم الشديد، والأيام بمعنى الوقائع.
يدخل فيه أيام الله وما في معناها من أيام النعم والوقائع التي يذكر بها، من عفو أو نعمة أو عذاب نزل بقوم.
تركيب يوم مع إذ في يومئذ للدلالة على وقت مشار إليه في السياق، مع جواز الإعراب أو البناء بحسب الإضافة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قال يقول قولا، والقول والقيل، والكلام المركب من الحروف إذا أبرز بالنطق، مفردا كان أو جملة أو قصيدة أو خطبة.
يدخل فيه المقول بمعنى اللسان.
يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.
يدخل فيه استعمال المنطقيين القول بمعنى الحد، كقول الجوهر وقول العرض أي حدهما.
يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.

يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى البلل والرطوبة والمطر والطل، وندى الشيء إذا ابتل، والأرض أو اليوم أو الليلة الندية.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, doğruluğu kesinleşmemiş bir sözü aktarma çekirdeğini destekler; ancak aktarılan sözün zorunlu olarak yalan olmadığını, doğru da yanlış da olabileceğini açıkça belirtir. Bu nedenle dal, kesin yalan söyleme olarak değil, çoğu kez kuşku veya yalan ihtimali taşıyan söz aktarımı olarak sınırlandırılmıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, doğrulanmamış söz aktarma çekirdeğini korur; türemiş biçimlerdeki yalanlama, güvenilmez iddia ve hayvanın semizliğinden kuşku duyma kullanımlarını bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmeler olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözü doğruluğu kesinleşmeden aktarmak veya ileri sürmektir; söz doğru ya da yanlış olabilir, fakat kullanım çoğu kez kuşku ve yalan ihtimali taşır. Türemiş kullanımlar, yalan yere iddiayı, güvenilmeyen söz veya işi ve semizliği belirsiz hayvanı bu güvenilmezlik ekseninde adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir söz, doğruluğu ve kesinliği sağlanmadan aktarılır veya ileri sürülür.
Aktarılan söz doğru da yanlış da olabilir; kullanımın ağırlık noktası kesin yalan değil, kuşku ve doğrulanmamışlıktır.
Bazı türemiş biçimler yalan söylemeyi, yalan yere iddiayı veya güvenilmeyen söz ve işleri belirtir.
Aynı güvenilmezlik örüntüsü, semiz olup olmadığı bilinmeyen ve elle yoklanan hayvan için de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğu kesinleşmemiş bir sözü aktarma veya ileri sürme çekirdeğinde birleşir; kullanım çoğu kez kuşku veya yalan ihtimali taşır, ancak söz her durumda yanlış değildir. Semizliği kuşkulu hayvan uzantısı Maqayis, Sihah ve Tahdhib'de; doğrulanmamış aktarımda kullanılan özel kuşku sözü yalnız Tahdhib'de yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin sorumluluğunu güvence veren olarak üstlenme çekirdeğini ve bu kişiye düşebilecek ödeme yükünü açıkça destekler. Topluluğun bir iş üzerinde birbirine destek olması ise aynı düzeyde bir güvence tanımı değil, üyelerin birbirine dayanak oluşundan türeyen ilişkili bir kullanımdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Güvence veren kişi ve güvence ilişkisi çekirdek tutulur; bir şey için güvence verme kalıpları ile topluluğun karşılıklı destek kalıbı ayrı kapsamlarla gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin yerine getirilmesi için sözle güvence vermek, sorumluluğunu üstlenmek ve gerekirse doğan yükü üzerine almaktır. Topluluğun bir işte birbirine destek olması, üyelerin birbirine güvence ve dayanak oluşuna bağlı ilişkili bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi veya karşılanması için sözle güvence verir ve sorumluluğu üstlenir.
Güvence veren kişi, yükümlülük yerine gelmezse doğan borcu veya yükü üstlenebilen sorumlu taraftır.
Kanıtlanan topluluk kalıbı, kişilerin bir iş üzerinde birleşip birbirine destek ve güvence olmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım herhangi bir özel kalıptan alınan boşluk, zaman veya söz açıklığı anlamını ithal etmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da tarafların önceki bağlantı, birliktelik veya yakınlıktan ayrılması, kopması ve birbirinden uzak düşmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam ayrılma, kopma ve tarafların birbirinden ayrı hale gelmesidir.
Ayrılık taraflar arasında uzaklaşma veya karşılıklı ayrışma biçiminde de anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda ayrılma ve kopma çekirdeğinde birleşir; bazı anlatımlar kesme yönünü, bazıları ise ayrışma ve uzaklaşma yönünü öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlik, temas veya yakınlık sonrasında gerçekleşen ayrılma çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrılma, kopma ve bağdan çıkma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarafların karşılıklı ayrıştığı sosyal, mekansal veya soyut bağlamlarda doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı ayrılma ve uzak düşme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme ve ayırma eylemini daha genel ve işlem odaklı verir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ayrılığın ve kopuşun kendisini anlatır; komşu dal ise kesme-fayırma işlemini daha doğrudan eylem çekirdeği yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kopma ve ayrılma olayını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal uzaklık, gurbet ve mesafe durumunu ayrılma işlemi olmadan da taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayrılma sonucunda mesafe ve uzaklık doğabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda ana çekirdek bağdan ayrılmadır; komşuda ana çekirdek yakın olmama ve uzak yerde bulunmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tarafların ayrılıp kopmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taraflar arasındaki orta, aralık veya ara konumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da taraflar arasındaki ilişkiyi konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkiyi koparan ayrışmayı verir; komşu dal taraflar arasındaki konum veya mesafeyi verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yayımlananlar ayrılma, uzaklık ve ara konumla en kolay karışabilecek sınırlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık ve iç bölge fikrini verir. Geçici çerçeve, eldeki kalıpları da ayrı kullanım olarak sakladığı sürece bu dalı doğru temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; yalın ara-konum çekirdeği ile belirli kalıplardaki yakınlık ve içinden olma kullanımları ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık, mesafe ya da iç konumdur; bazı kalıplarda birine yakın veya bir topluluğun içinden olma anlamına bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki veya daha çok taraf arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konumdur.
Belirli kalıplarda birinin önünde, yanında veya yakınında bulunma anlamı doğar.
Bir topluluğun içinden veya o topluluğa dahil bir unsur olarak seçilmeyi anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar orta ve aralık çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca kullanımın iki veya daha çok tarafı gerektirdiği ve bazı kalıplarda yakınlık ya da içinden olma verdiği anlaşılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taraflar arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konum çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Orta konum, aralık ve taraflar arası ilişkiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki veya daha çok şeyin ortasında, aralığında ya da içinde konum bildiren akıcı metinlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arası konumu ve aralık fikrini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluk içinden seçilme veya o topluluğa dahil olma kalıbında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk içinden olma kullanımını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal daha genel taraflar arası konumu verir; komşu dal aradaki açık boşluğu ve geçit niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakınlık ve bitişiklik ekseninde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da konumsal ilişki ve mesafe eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aradaki konumu veya mesafeyi kurar; komşu dal bu mesafenin azalması ya da yokluğu olan yakınlığı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal aralık veya orta konumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılma ve kopma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de taraflar arasındaki ilişkiyi düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tarafların arasında ne bulunduğunu söyler; komşu dal tarafların bağdan ayrılmasını söyler.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بين الظرفية والاسمية: الوسط والخلال والمسافة بين اثنين فصاعدا، وما بين الأيدي بمعنى المتقدم أو القريب، ومن بين القوم بمعنى من جملتهم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بين بمعنى وسط (sihah)؛ بين موضوع للخلالة بين الشيئين ووسطهما (mufradat)؛ لا يستعمل بين إلا فيما كان له مسافة أو له عدد ما اثنان فصاعدا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ayrılığın zıddı olan bağ, ilişki ve insanlar arasında toparlayıcı durumlar alanını açıkça verir. Geçici çerçeve bu ilişki kurucu çekirdeği doğru taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; yalın bağ anlamı ile insanlar arasındaki durumları anlatan özel kalıp ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Taraflar arasında kopmayı değil, onları birleştiren bağ, ilişki, yakınlık veya dostluk durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam taraflar arasında bulunan bağ ve bağlantıdır.
İnsanlar arasında yakınlık, akrabalık ve sevgiyle toplu durumu anlatan kalıp kullanımı vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda bağ ve bağlantı çekirdeğini verir; özel kullanımda insanlar arasındaki akrabalık, yakınlık ve sevgi durumları bu bağın görünümü olarak açıklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağın kendisini verir; komşu dal bozulan ilişkinin onarılması eylemini verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal birleştirici ilişkiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılıp kopmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı taraflar arası bağ ekseninin karşı yönlerinde durur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bağın sürmesini veya varlığını gösterir; komşu dal bağın kopmasını gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; bağ, barışma ve kopuş karşıtlığı okuyucu için en belirgin sınırları oluşturur.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البين بمعنى الوصل، وذات البين التي تجمع الناس من قرابة أو وصلة أو مودة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البين الوصل (ayn;sihah)؛ لقد تقطع بينكم أي وصلكم (mufradat)؛ ذات بينكم أي الأحوال التي تجمعكم من القرابة والوصلة والمودة (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بان وأبان وتبين واستبان إذا ظهر الشيء واتضح، والبينة والدلالة الواضحة، والآيات البينات.
يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
يدخل فيه البين من الأرض: القطعة أو الناحية أو الغلظ من الأرض بقدر مد البصر.

branches.branch_image_ar: انفراج العضو أو الشيء عن ملاصقه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها، والقوس البائنة التي بان وترها عن كبدها، وإبانة الرأس من الجسد.
يدخل فيه البائن في الحلب: أحد الحالبين أو الذي يأتي الحلوبة من قبل شمالها مقابل المستعلي أو المعلى.

branches.branch_image_ar: الوقت الواقع أثناء حال أو فعل
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بينا وبينما إذا جعلتا بمنزلة حين وأضافتا الجملة إلى زمن الفعل.
يدخل فيه بين بين: ما كان بين الجيد والرديء، أو الهمزة المخففة بين الهمزة وحرف اللين، أو الضعيف غير المعتد به في الشاهد.
يدخل فيه تطليقة بائنة، أي طلاق فاعلة فيه بمعنى مفعولة يدل على انقطاع الرجعة.
يدخل فيه غراب البين بوصفه الغراب الذي يتشاءم به للفراق في الخبر اللغوي.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kanıt, anlamı yalın ya da belirli bir yapıya kesin olarak bağlamaz; bu nedenle tanım yalnızca kaynak ifadesindeki ad değerini korur.

concept_map.definition: İki ayrı şeyin arasında bulunarak onları birbirinden ayıran engel ya da ara unsurdur.

facets.statement: İki şeyin arasına giren ve onları birbirinden ayıran bir unsur olma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, iki şeyin arasında bulunan her ayırıcı unsurun bu anlam kapsamında olduğunu belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tamamında, aralarında ayırıcı bir unsur bulunan iki ayrı şey söz konusu olduğunda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.adds: Araya girmeyen güçlükleri ve soyut engellemeleri de kapsama alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı, iki şeyin arasına giren somut ya da kavramsal ayırıcı unsuru belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda iki alanı ya da unsuru birbirinden ayırma düşüncesi bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem bir varlığın yok olmasını hem de bir etkenin başka bir varlığı yok etmesini açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi, kendiliğinden gerçekleşen sonuç ile bu sonuca uğratma arasındaki katılımcı değişimini doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kanıt bu anlamı yalın biçimde hem yok olma hem de ettirgen biçimde yok etme olarak verir; tanım belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlanmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yok olma, bozulma, düşme, kayıp, öldürme ve takılı kalma alanındaki bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; en yakın iki anlamdaşımsı dal ile süreç-sonuç ayrımını gösteren kök içi dal seçildi.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وبق بمعنى هلك، وأوبقه بمعنى أهلكه، وما كان مهلكا لغيره.
branches.source_phrase_ar: وبق: هلك، وأوبقه الله (maqayis)؛ وبق الإنسان إذا هلك وبقا وأوبقته أنا إيباقا (jamhara)؛ وبق يبق وبوقا: هلك، وأوبقه أي أهلكه (sihah)؛ أوبقت فلانا ذنوبه أي أهلكته فوبق يوبق وبقا وموبقا إذا هلك (tahdhib)؛ وبق إذا تثبط فهلك، وأوبقه كذا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çamurda saplanmayı, işlenen kötülükten kurtulamamayı, ilerleyemeyip yok olmayı ve başkalarını alıkoyarak boğulmalarına yol açmayı birlikte verir. Takılıp kurtulamama çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak her kullanımın aynı sonucu taşıdığı varsayılmamalı ve yalın biçim ile belirli yapılara bağlı yönler ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimde engellenip sonunda yok olma yönü ile çamura saplanma, işlenen kötülükten kurtulamama ve başkalarını alıkoyma gibi yapıya bağlı yönleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Takılıp kalma ya da alıkonma yüzünden kurtulamamaktır; bazı kullanımlarda bu durum yok oluşla sonuçlanır. Çamura saplanma ve işlenen kötülükten sıyrılamama belirli yapılara bağlıdır; ettirgen yapıda başkalarını alıkoyup boğularak ölmelerine yol açma anlatılır.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın takılıp kalması ya da alıkonması nedeniyle kurtulamaması.
Yalın kullanımda ilerleyemeyip sonunda yok olma.
Hayvanların çamura saplanıp orada takılı kalması.
Bir kişinin işlediği kötülüğe saplanıp ondan sıyrılamaması.
Ettirgen yapıda başkalarını alıkoyarak boğulup ölmelerine yol açma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak açıklaması, takılıp kurtulamama çekirdeğini çamura saplanma ve işlenen kötülükten sıyrılamama ile örnekler; ayrıca ilerleyemeyip yok olma ve başkalarını alıkoyarak boğulmalarına yol açma yönlerini verir.
